purpose: Static RG classification recomputes dependent localparams from the model's len=; the O card carries no length (ngspice 44.2 refuses a card length=, and so does ESPice). ngspice 44.2 -b on this deck: v(out) 1.353353e-01, vin#branch -1.00000e+00.

oracle.derivation: For R=G=1 and length=2, the exact static two-port has A=cosh(2), B=sinh(2)*(1+gmin). With Vin=1 and RL=1, Vout=1/(A+B), Iin=(A-Vout)/B. gmin=1e-12 matches the documented host default.
